description: This Java class defines an HTTP endpoint for managing device registration information within the Eclipse Hono framework. It handles HTTP routes for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting devices, and communicates via Vert.x event bus for processing device management actions.

classes.name: DeviceManagementHttpEndpoint
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractHttpEndpoint that provides HTTP route handling for device management operations such as create, get, update, and delete.

methods.name: DeviceManagementHttpEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor accepting a Vertx instance, annotated for dependency injection, to initialize the endpoint.

methods.name: getEventBusAddress
methods.description: Returns the specific event bus address used for device management messages.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the endpoint, combining API version and endpoint identifier.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Registers HTTP routes with handlers for device create, get, update, and delete operations, including CORS configuration.

methods.name: doGetDevice
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve device information, sending messages over the event bus and responding accordingly.

methods.name: doCreateDevice
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new device, validating payload and sending creation message via event bus.

methods.name: doUpdateDevice
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update device info, sending update message on the event bus.

methods.name: doDeleteDevice
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to remove a device, sending delete message over event bus.
